key_insight: Adding higher-resolution MTG/FCI imagery improves CNN-based surface solar irradiance retrieval mainly when clouds dominate, but it does not fix clear-sky errors.
engineering_relevance: For photovoltaic monitoring and forecasting, the hybrid MTG/FCI + MSG/SEVIRI model can yield better short-term irradiance estimates in cloudy conditions, supporting more reliable operational solar energy workflows.
method: Multi-imager CNN for 10-minute SSI retrieval over Estonia
Inputs: MSG/SEVIRI and MTG/FCI imagery plus solar geometry and clear-sky irradiance features
Compared hybrid SEVIRI-FCI vs SEVIRI-only and against SARAH-3
evidence_signal: Evaluated with site-based cross-validation on pyranometer data from eight Estonian stations across multiple training seeds, with the hybrid model reducing RMSE by 8.2 W/m² under overcast and 5.7 W/m² under cloudy conditions.
watch_item: Higher spatial resolution alone was not enough to improve clear-sky performance, so additional features or model changes are still needed for those regimes.
paper_title: Meteosat Third Generation imagery improves CNN-based SSI retrieval
